name: LITTLE SYNDICATE: My First Territory
description: A children's territory-control board game marketed to ages 5–10, featuring brightly colored cartoon corponation mascots competing to 'deliver the most services' to a cheerful city grid — but the mechanics are unmistakably those of resource extraction, protection rackets, and hostile takeover. Players who fall behind lose 'community tiles' to richer players automatically, with no mechanic to recover them; the rules sheet describes this as 'how cities grow strong together.'
story_hooks: A parent finds that their child's copy of Little Syndicate contains a game variant booklet that wasn't in the box when purchased — teaching rules about sabotage and information suppression.
A Shelf teacher uses the game to teach children to identify and resist the exact psychological patterns it's designed to normalize.
A journalist investigating Sunward Consumer Division traces the game's designer — who has been missing since 2206.
